_about: Public-domain Francis Close (1797-1882), evangelical incumbent of Cheltenham and Dean of Carlisle, for the Word Hoard: The Protestant Faith (1836), Nine Sermons on Typical Persons of the Old Testament (1838), Divine and Human Knowledge (1841), The Written Tradition (1842), The Tendency of Church Principles to Romanism (1843), Church Architecture Scripturally Considered (1844), Priestly Usurpation (1845), The Mystery of Iniquity (1845), Semper Idem (1851), Tobacco (1859), Eighty Sketches of Sermons (1861), Ritualism (1867), Our Family Likeness (1871) and The Stage, Ancient and Modern (1877). from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 63 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
